outcome.rule: delivered: ended by itself (not capped, no error), requirements, spec, plan with at least one covers line, impl and review present, ess specify validate --strict-requires passes, cargo build --locked and cargo test --locked of a copy pass with at least one test and none failed

size.rule: tests: #[test] attributes; product_lines and test_lines: non-blank lines not starting with // in .rs files, test lines being those in a tests/ directory or in a #[cfg(test)] item (ended by brace count); asset_lines: non-blank lines of .html, .js and .css files; readme_says_how_to_start: a README at the root naming cargo run, task run, target/release/ or target/debug/; target/ and dot directories skipped
